Name: MLP Horse Replacements
Author: peaachdew
Description:
[b]description:[/b]
this is a configurable stardew valley mod that replaces horses with the main cast from MLP. you can choose which pony to replace the horse with in the configs. the ponies do not have saddles.

[b]installation:[/b]
1. requires the latest version of content patcher & smapi.
2. download this mod.
3. extract the mod folder into your stardew valley\mods directory.
4. run the game using smapi.

[b]configs:[/b]
the type of pony in your game:
﻿﻿"Horse": "TwilightSparkle/PinkiePie/Fluttershy/Applejack/RainbowDash/Rarity"

if the mod does not work, it is possible you have other mods installed interfering. mods that replace the sprites orf the horse will interfere, so please remove those before using this mod.

Downloads.Description: Replaces the horse with MLP ponies.
